Bill.title: Bill
Bill.description: A single daily expense record with item name, price in VND, category, payment status, date, and owner ID.

userId.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the user who owns this expense record.

name.description: Name or description of the expense item.

amount.description: Expense price amount in VND (strictly positive number).

date.description: Calendar date of the expense in YYYY-MM-DD format.

isPaid.description: Payment status flag: true for paid (Đã thanh toán), false for unpaid (Chưa thanh toán).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the record was last updated.

/bills/{billId}.description: Collection of daily expense records owned by authenticated users.
